title: IVG Savr 3000 Double Apple Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Double Apple IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods combine sweet Red Apple and tart Green Apple for a crisp and refreshing flavour. The balanced blend offers a clean fruit profile with just the right level of natural sweetness and bite. Each pod pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 4ml refill reservoir containing 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid. Together they support up to 3000 puffs per kit and connect seamlessly into the IVG Savr 3000 device — no coil changes or manual top-ups required. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
